cards.card_text: Job says he has become a brother of jackals, a companion of ostriches.
cards.verse_text: I have become a brother of jackals, a companion of ostriches.
cards.snippet: I have become a brother of jackals, a companion of ostriches.

cards.card_text: Now the LORD gets to the ostrich, whose wings flap joyfully but can't match the stork's pinions and feathers.
cards.verse_text: The wings of the ostrich flap joyfully, but cannot match the pinions and feathers of the stork.
cards.snippet: The wings of the ostrich flap joyfully, but cannot match the pinions and feathers of the stork.

cards.card_text: Desert creatures and ostriches Lions and wolves Eagles and ravens
cards.verse_text: Ostriches will dwell there, and wild goats will leap about.
cards.snippet: Ostriches will dwell there, and wild goats will leap about.

cards.card_text: Jackals and ostriches will move in, the desert creatures will meet with hyenas, and one wild goat will call to another.
cards.verse_text: She will become a haunt for jackals, an abode for ostriches.
cards.snippet: She will become a haunt for jackals, an abode for ostriches.

cards.card_text: The LORD will make streams in the desert too, and the jackals and the ostriches will honor Him for it.
cards.verse_text: The beasts of the field will honor Me, the jackals and the ostriches, because I provide water in the wilderness and rivers in the desert, to give drink to My chosen people.
cards.snippet: The beasts of the field will honor Me, the jackals and the ostriches, because I provide water in the wilderness and rivers in the desert,…

cards.card_text: So desert creatures, hyenas and ostriches will move in.
cards.verse_text: So the desert creatures and hyenas will live there and ostriches will dwell there.
cards.snippet: So the desert creatures and hyenas will live there and ostriches will dwell there.

cards.card_text: But the poet says the daughter of his people has become ___, like an ostrich in the wilderness.
cards.verse_text: Even jackals offer their breasts to nurse their young, but the daughter of my people has become cruel, like an ostrich in the wilderness.
cards.snippet: …young, but the daughter of my people has become cruel, like an ostrich in the wilderness.
